en: Illustrated military-themed postcard showing a uniformed soldier standing beside two pack ponies loaded with gear in a light winter or autumn landscape with birch trees. The border has a decorative pattern of red, black, and white squares. Text in Swedish and Finnish appears under the illustration, and there is a date and signature-like mark at the lower left ("Haga 12/4 1918").
